headline: True-positive multi-stage cloud attack with confirmed data access/exfiltration against proddata001
summary: Between 2026-07-17 22:56:17 and 2026-07-17 22:56:34, the report confirms a true-positive multi-stage attack from 185.220.101.42 involving reconnaissance, credential access, discovery, collection, and exfiltration activity. Evidence shows SAS access to a non-public container, service principal authentication via client_secret, IMDS token retrieval from webapp-vm-001, storage account key retrieval for PRODDATA001, and blob access including customer-pii and database-backups. Data access/exfiltration is confirmed.

items.title: Immediate containment priority
items.detail: Prioritize containment around the active source IP and all affected credentials/assets explicitly identified in the report: SAS:deployments, managed identity on webapp-vm-001, service principal aabbccdd-1122-3344-5566-778899aabbcc, and storage account PRODDATA001.
